title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
summary: Hold until the named-plan licensing statement is corrected: the current Agent 365 service description no longer states the Enterprise, Business, Education and Front Line Worker inclusion the briefing attributes to it. The installation and blocking paths, Graph calls, administrator-controlled access and rollout dates are supported; several documentation disagreements need minor qualifications.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A2A-specific additional charges are not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Agent2Agent declarative billing Credits'; A2A connected-agent additional-charge query. Read prerequisites, Agent 365 service description, Copilot pay-as-you-go meters and Studio billing excerpts; no registered-A2A-specific additional rate found.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published whether a particular installed external A2A agent carries its own separate charge.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Agent2Agent A2A connected agents Copilot Credits billing price additional charge Agent 365'. Read Agent 365 service description, overview, connection guide and Copilot meters; none specifies a separate vendor-agent charge for registered A2A agents invoked by declarative agents.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published whether invoking a registered A2A agent through a declarative connection itself consumes Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Agent2Agent declarative billing Credits'. Read prerequisites, Copilot meters, Agent 365 service description and Studio billing excerpts; none identifies credit consumption of a registered-A2A invocation through a declarative agent.

claims.claim: The general package-update reference does not describe applicability to Agent2Agent registrations.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Agent2Agent copilot/admin/catalog/packages block deployment'. Read package-update reference, Package Management API overview and Agent Registration API overview; package deployment properties are documented, but mapping an A2A registration to a deployable package is not stated.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions
claims.claim: The cited general blocking documentation does not specifically confirm stopping a registered A2A agent through a declarative-agent connection.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Agent2Agent copilot/admin/catalog/packages block deployment'. Read agent-actions, package-block, Package Management API overview and Agent Registration API overview. General user/package blocking is stated; A2A registration blocking and effects on connections are not specifically described.

claims.claim: The cited sources do not reconcile the roadmap's Agent Builder and Copilot Studio wording with the notice's Toolkit-built declarative-agent description.
